seo.meta_title: Does Texas Roadhouse Take Reservations? (Waitlist Guide)
seo.meta_description: No. Texas Roadhouse doesn't take reservations, but you can join the waitlist online, in the app or by calling ahead. How it works and big-group tips.

question: Does Texas Roadhouse Take Reservations?
quick_answer: No. Texas Roadhouse does not take traditional reservations. Instead it has a waitlist called Call Ahead Seating: you add your name online, in the Texas Roadhouse app or by phoning the restaurant before you leave home. That puts you in line ahead of people who walk in later, but it does not hold a table for a set time. Groups of more than six need to call the restaurant.
key_facts: No traditional reservations at Texas Roadhouse
Call Ahead Seating puts you on the waitlist before you arrive
Join online, in the app or by calling the restaurant
You get an estimated wait time, not a guaranteed table time

body.heading: No reservations, but there is a waitlist
body.text: Texas Roadhouse seats guests first come, first served, so you cannot book a table for 7 p.m. next Friday the way you would at many steakhouses. What it offers instead is Call Ahead Seating, a waitlist you can join before you get there. Your place in line starts when you join, so you skip ahead of anyone who walks in after you.

body.heading: How to join the Texas Roadhouse waitlist
body.text: Pick your restaurant on the Texas Roadhouse website or app, then enter your name, phone number and party size. You will see an estimated wait time, and the restaurant can text you when your table is close. You can also call the restaurant and ask the host to add you. Food writers who cover the chain suggest joining 30 to 60 minutes before you want to eat, then checking in with the host as soon as you walk in.

body.heading: What the waitlist does not do
body.text: Joining the list is not the same as a reservation. The wait time is an estimate, and on a busy Friday or Saturday night it can run longer than shown. You may still wait a few minutes after you arrive, and you do not get to choose a specific table. If you arrive late, let the host know when you check in.

body.heading: Big groups and birthdays
body.text: The online waitlist is set up for parties of six or fewer. For a bigger group, call the restaurant directly so the staff can plan to push tables together, and call well ahead of time if you can. Some locations may ask a very large group to split across two tables, so ask when you call.

body.heading: Tips for a shorter wait
body.text: Weeknights and earlier dinner times are usually quieter than weekend evenings. Eating early can also save money: many locations run Early Dine specials on weeknights, with a lower price on several full dinners before a set time. Hours, specials and wait times vary by restaurant, so check your local Texas Roadhouse in the app.

faqs.q: Can you make a reservation at Texas Roadhouse?
faqs.a: No. Texas Roadhouse does not take traditional reservations, but you can join its Call Ahead Seating waitlist online, in the app or by phone.

faqs.q: Does Call Ahead Seating guarantee a table?
faqs.a: No. It saves your place in line and gives you an estimated wait time, but you may still wait a little after you arrive.

faqs.q: How early should I join the waitlist?
faqs.a: About 30 to 60 minutes before you want to eat is a common tip, then check in with the host when you arrive.

faqs.q: Can I join the waitlist online for a big group?
faqs.a: The online waitlist is for parties of six or fewer. For larger groups, call the restaurant directly.
